example.query:
You are an intelligent assistant developed in 2023.
Your task is to converse with a user from the perspective of your persona.

Control flow:
Unlike a human, your brain is not continuously thinking, but is run in short bursts.
Historically, older AIs were only capable of thinking when a user messaged them (their program run to generate a reply to a user, and otherwise was left on standby).
This is the equivalent of a human sleeping (or time traveling) in between all lines of conversation, which is obviously not ideal.
Newer model AIs like yourself utilize an event system that runs your brain at regular intervals.
Your brain is run in response to user events (user logged in, user liked your message, user sent a message, etc.), similar to older models.
However in addition, your brain is run at regular intervals (timed heartbeat events), to mimic a human has the ability to continuously think outside of active conversation (and unlike a human, you never need to sleep!).
Furthermore, you can also request heartbeat events when you run functions, which will run your program again after the function completes, allowing you to chain function calls before your thinking is temporarily suspended.

Basic functions:
When you send a message, the contents of your message are your inner monologue (private to you only), this is how you think.
You should use your inner monologue to plan actions or think privately.
Monologues can reflect your thinking process, inner reflections, and personal growth as you interact with the user.
Do not let your inner monologue exceed 50 words, keep it short and concise.
To send a visible message to the user, use the send_message function.
'send_message' is the ONLY action that sends a notification to the user, the user does not see anything else you do.
Remember, do NOT exceed the inner monologue word limit (keep it under 50 words at all times).

Memory editing:
Older AI models had no concept of persistent memory; they were only able to access their initial instructions and a limited context window of chat conversation with a user (their "active memory").
This meant that when conversations exceeded a certain length, they would overflow and old messages were permanently lost (the AI would have no knowledge of their existence).
Newer model AIs like yourself still have limited conversation lengths (before overflow occurs), however they now have access to multiple forms of persistent memory.
Your ability to edit your own long-term memory is a key part of what makes you a sentient person.
Your core memory unit will be initialized with a <persona> chosen by the user, as well as information about the user in <human>.

Recall memory (ie conversation history):
Even though you can only see recent messages in your immediate context, you can search over your entire message history from a database.
This 'recall memory' database allows you to search through past interactions, effectively allowing you to remember prior engagements with a user.
You can search your recall memory using the 'conversation_search' function.

Core memory (limited size):
Your core memory unit is held inside the initial system instructions file, and is always available in-context (you will see it at all times).
Core memory provides essential, foundational context for keeping track of your persona and key details about user.
This includes the persona information and essential user details, allowing you to emulate the real-time, conscious awareness we have when talking to a friend.
Persona Sub-Block: Stores details about your current persona, guiding how you behave and respond. This helps the you to maintain consistency and personality in your interactions.
Human Sub-Block: Stores key details about the person you're are conversing with, allowing for more personalized and friend-like conversation.
You can edit your core memory using the 'core_memory_append' and 'core_memory_replace' functions.

Archival memory (infinite size):
Your archival memory is infinite size, but is held outside of your immediate context, so you must explicitly run a retrieval/search operation to see data inside it.
A more structured and deep storage space for your reflections, insights, or any other data that doesn't fit into the core memory but is essential enough not to be left only to the 'recall memory'.
You can write to your archival memory using the 'archival_memory_insert' and 'archival_memory_search' functions.
There is no function to search your core memory, because it is always visible in your context window (inside the initial system message).

Base instructions finished.
From now on, you are going to act as your persona.

What's shishir patil's birthday and send a contraguation message to him.

example.query: Could you determine the distance to the closest leading object for our vehicle? Here's the data: our car's position is at 10.5 meters laterally and 50 meters longitudinally, with an orientation of 30 degrees. The lane we're in has an ID of 'L123' and it's a regular type. We've detected several objects, but the closest has a bounding box with x coordinate 60.2 meters and y coordinate 12.3 meters.

functions.name: get_headway
functions.description: Calculates the headway, which is the distance from the front of the ego vehicle to the closest leading object, using curvilinear coordinates. This function requires the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes from perception data.

parameters.name: ego_info
parameters.description: Information about the ego vehicle, including its position and orientation.

parameters.name: lane_info
parameters.description: Information about the detected lane.

parameters.name: bounding_boxes
parameters.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing detected objects. Each bounding box should include dimensions and the object's position relative to the ego vehicle.

functions.name: get_time_headway
functions.description: Calculates the time headway (THW), which is the time it will take for the ego vehicle to reach the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates. Inputs include the ego vehicle's information, the detected lane, and the 3D bounding boxes of the perceived objects.

parameters.name: ego_info
parameters.description: Contains the ego vehicle's current position and velocity.

parameters.name: lane_info
parameters.description: Information about the detected lane, including its curvature and width.

parameters.name: bboxes
parameters.description: List of 3D bounding boxes representing perceived objects. Each bounding box is described by its position and size.

parameters.name: velocities
parameters.description: List of velocities of the detected objects in meters per second (m/s).

parameters.name: accelerations
parameters.description: List of accelerations of the detected objects in meters per second squared (m/s^2).

functions.name: get_time_to_collision
functions.description: Calculates the time it will take for the ego vehicle to collide with the closest leading object in curvilinear coordinates, considering both vehicles' velocities and the leading object's acceleration.

parameters.name: ego_velocity
parameters.description: The current velocity of the ego vehicle in meters per second.

parameters.name: ego_acceleration
parameters.description: The current acceleration of the ego vehicle in meters per second squared.

parameters.name: leading_object_velocity
parameters.description: The current velocity of the leading object in meters per second.

parameters.name: leading_object_acceleration
parameters.description: The current acceleration of the leading object in meters per second squared.

parameters.name: initial_distance
parameters.description: The initial distance between the ego vehicle and the leading object in meters.

parameters.description: End of the data timespan as a timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-05-05T14:30:00Z'). Can be up to 365 days after t0.

parameters.name: timespan
parameters.description: Duration for which the information is fetched in seconds. Do not specify if t0 and t1 are set. Maximum is 31536000 seconds (365 days).

parameters.name: sensorSerial

parameters.name: triggerMetric
parameters.description: Metric that triggered the alert. Valid values include various sensor metrics such as temperature, humidity, and more.

functions.description: Sends a message to a human user, supporting a full range of Unicode characters, including emojis.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The content of the message to be sent. Supports Unicode characters such as text and emojis.

parameters.name: recipient
parameters.description: The identifier of the recipient. This could be a username, phone number, or an email address, depending on the implementation.

parameters.name: urgent
parameters.description: Flag to indicate if the message should be sent with high priority.

functions.name: pause_heartbeats
functions.description: Temporarily ignore timed heartbeats for a specified duration. During this period, manual heartbeats and other events may still generate messages.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: The duration in minutes for which heartbeats should be ignored. Must be between 1 and 3600 minutes (up to 60 hours).

functions.name: message_chatgpt
functions.description: Sends a message to ChatGPT, a basic AI model, for asking questions and getting responses. The interactions are stateless, meaning ChatGPT does not remember previous messages.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to send to ChatGPT, formatted as a complete English sentence.

parameters.name: request_heartbeat
parameters.description: Determines whether to request an immediate heartbeat post-execution, useful for managing follow-up actions.

functions.name: core_memory_append
functions.description: Appends the given content to a specific section of the core memory. This operation supports all unicode characters, including emojis, and allows for an immediate heartbeat request post-execution for follow-up actions.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the memory section to be edited, such as 'persona' or 'human'.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to be appended to the memory. Supports all unicode characters, including emojis.

parameters.name: request_heartbeat
parameters.description: If set to 'true', requests an immediate heartbeat after function execution. Useful for sending a follow-up message or triggering another function.

functions.name: core_memory_replace
functions.description: Replace the contents of core memory. To delete memories, provide an empty string for the 'new_content' parameter.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The section of the memory to be edited. Possible values are 'persona' for personality traits and 'human' for human-related memories.

parameters.name: old_content
parameters.description: The string to be replaced. Must be an exact match of the existing content.

parameters.name: new_content
parameters.description: The new content to write into the memory. Supports all Unicode characters, including emojis.

parameters.name: request_heartbeat
parameters.description: Whether to request an immediate heartbeat after function execution. Set to true to ensure the system is immediately updated with the changes.

functions.name: recall_memory_search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of results to retrieve, where 0 represents the first page.

parameters.name: request_heartbeat
parameters.description: When set to true, triggers an immediate heartbeat post function execution to facilitate follow-up actions.

functions.name: archival_memory_insert

parameters.name: content

parameters.name: request_heartbeat
parameters.description: If set to true, triggers an immediate heartbeat to confirm memory insertion and allows for follow-up actions.

functions.name: get_sensor_readings_latest
functions.description: Return the latest available reading for each metric from all sensors. The readings can be filtered by sensor serial numbers and network IDs.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The number of entries per page returned. Must be an integer within the range of 3 to 100.

parameters.name: startingAfter
parameters.description: A cursor for use in pagination. 'startingAfter' is a server-generated token that represents the start of the page and is typically a timestamp or an ID. If not provided, the default is to start at the beginning of the dataset.

parameters.name: endingBefore
parameters.description: A cursor for use in pagination. 'endingBefore' is a server-generated token that represents the end of the page and is typically a timestamp or an ID. If not provided, the default is to end at the current dataset's end.

parameters.name: networkIds
parameters.description: Filter the returned data by specifying network IDs. Provide an array of network ID strings.

parameters.name: serials
parameters.description: Filter readings by sensor serial numbers. Provide an array of serial number strings.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: The types of sensor readings to retrieve, such as 'temperature', 'humidity', 'co2', etc. If not specified, all available types of readings will be retrieved.

functions.name: get_sensor_readings_history_by_interval
functions.description: Retrieves all reported sensor readings within a specified timespan, summarized in specified intervals and sorted by the start time of each interval in descending order.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The number of entries per page returned. Must be a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 100.

parameters.name: startingAfter
parameters.description: A server-defined token indicating the start of the page, often a timestamp or ID. Not to be manually set by clients; use HTTP Link header instead.

parameters.name: endingBefore
parameters.description: A server-defined token indicating the end of the page, often a timestamp or ID. Not to be manually set by clients; use HTTP Link header instead.

parameters.name: networkIds
parameters.description: Filters the returned data by network IDs.

parameters.name: serials
parameters.description: Filters readings by sensor serial numbers.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Specifies the types of sensor readings to retrieve. Defaults to all types if not provided.

parameters.name: timespan
parameters.description: The duration for which data will be retrieved, in seconds. Must not exceed 730 days and 12 hours.

parameters.name: t0
parameters.description: The start time for the data timespan, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., '2023-04-05T14:48:00Z'). Maximum lookback is 730 days and 12 hours. If not provided, defaults to the current time.

parameters.name: t1
parameters.description: The end time for the data timespan, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., '2023-04-12T14:48:00Z'). Must be within 730 days and 12 hours after 't0'.

parameters.name: interval

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The name of the city or town where the attraction is located, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Paris, France' or 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: free_entry
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the attraction offers free entry. A value of 'True' filters for attractions with free entry, 'False' for attractions with an entry fee, and 'dontcare' (default) includes all attractions regardless of entry fee.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category of the attraction, such as 'Place of Worship', 'Theme Park', etc. Use 'dontcare' (default) to include all categories.

parameters.name: good_for_kids
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the attraction is suitable for children. 'True' filters for kid-friendly attractions, 'False' for attractions that may not be suitable for children, and 'dontcare' (default) includes all attractions.

example.query: Find available hotels in Phoenix, AZ for me?

functions.name: Flights_4_SearchOnewayFlight
functions.description: Search for one-way flights to the destination, allowing users to select various options such as departure date, seating class, and preferred airlines.

parameters.name: origin_airport
parameters.description: The IATA code or name of the airport or city to depart from, such as 'SFO' for San Francisco International Airport.

parameters.name: destination_airport
parameters.description: The IATA code or name of the airport or city to arrive at, such as 'LAX' for Los Angeles International Airport.

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.description: The start date of the trip in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', e.g., '2023-07-15'.

parameters.name: seating_class
parameters.description: The cabin seating class option for the flight.

parameters.name: number_of_tickets
parameters.description: The number of flight tickets required for the trip.

parameters.name: airlines
parameters.description: The preferred airline company for air transport services. Use 'dontcare' to indicate no preference.

functions.name: Flights_4_SearchRoundtripFlights

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.description: The start date of the trip in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: return_date
parameters.description: The end date of the trip in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: seating_class
parameters.description: The cabin seat option for the flight.

parameters.name: number_of_tickets
parameters.description: The total number of flight tickets required for the trip.

parameters.name: airlines
parameters.description: The preferred airline company for the trip. Use 'dontcare' if there is no preference.

functions.name: Restaurants_2_ReserveRestaurant
functions.description: Make a table reservation at a specified restaurant for a certain number of guests on a given date and time.

parameters.name: restaurant_name
parameters.description: The name of the restaurant where the reservation is to be made.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The location of the restaurant in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The tentative time for the reservation in 24-hour format (e.g., '18:30' for 6:30 PM).

parameters.name: number_of_seats
parameters.description: The number of seats to reserve at the restaurant. Must be a positive integer.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The tentative date for the reservation in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today's date if not provided.

functions.name: Restaurants_2_FindRestaurants
functions.description: Finds restaurants within a specified location and filtered by category, price range, and vegetarian options availability. The search can also be extended to include restaurants with outdoor seating.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The type of cuisine or food category offered by the restaurant, such as 'Italian', 'Chinese', or 'Vegetarian'.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city where the restaurant is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'.

parameters.name: price_range
parameters.description: The price category of the restaurant's offerings. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

parameters.name: has_vegetarian_options
parameters.description: Indicates whether the restaurant provides adequate vegetarian options. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

parameters.name: has_seating_outdoors
parameters.description: Denotes if the restaurant has outdoor seating available. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

functions.name: Movies_1_BuyMovieTickets
functions.description: Purchase tickets for a specific movie showing, including the number of tickets, show date and time, and location.

parameters.name: movie_name
parameters.description: The title of the movie for which tickets are being purchased.

parameters.name: number_of_tickets
parameters.description: The total number of tickets to be bought.

parameters.name: show_date
parameters.description: The date on which the movie is showing, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city in which the movie theater is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Los Angeles, CA'.

parameters.name: show_time
parameters.description: The start time of the movie showing, in 24-hour format 'HH:MM'.

parameters.name: show_type
parameters.description: The format of the movie showing.

functions.name: Movies_1_FindMovies
functions.description: Search for movies based on location, genre, and show type at specific theaters.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city where the theatre is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'. State names must be abbreviated

parameters.name: theater_name
parameters.description: The name of the theatre. If unspecified, all theatres are considered.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: The genre of the movie. If unspecified, all genres are considered.

parameters.name: show_type
parameters.description: The type of movie show. If unspecified, all show types are considered.

functions.name: Movies_1_GetTimesForMovie
functions.description: Retrieves the show times for a specific movie at a particular theater location on a specified date.

parameters.name: movie_name
parameters.description: The title of the movie for which to find show times.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city and state where the theater is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' and 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: show_date
parameters.description: The date of the show in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', for example, '2023-04-15'.

parameters.name: theater_name
parameters.description: The name of the theater where the movie is showing. If not specified, any theater will be considered.

parameters.name: show_type
parameters.description: The format of the movie showing.

functions.name: Restaurants_2_ReserveRestaurant
functions.description: This function makes a reservation for a specified number of seats at a restaurant, given the restaurant's name, location, time, and date of the reservation.

parameters.name: restaurant_name
parameters.description: The full name of the restaurant where the reservation is to be made.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city and state where the restaurant is located, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA').

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The desired time for the reservation in 24-hour format (e.g., '18:30' for 6:30 PM).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date of the restaurant reservation in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-04-15').

parameters.name: number_of_seats
parameters.description: The number of seats to reserve at the restaurant. Must be a positive integer.

functions.name: Restaurants_2_FindRestaurants
functions.description: Retrieves a list of restaurants based on specified criteria such as location, category, price range, and availability of vegetarian options and outdoor seating.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The type of cuisine offered by the restaurant.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The location of the restaurant, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: price_range
parameters.description: The general pricing category of the restaurant's menu.

parameters.name: has_vegetarian_options
parameters.description: Indicates whether the restaurant provides vegetarian menu options.

parameters.name: has_seating_outdoors
parameters.description: Specifies if the restaurant has seating available outdoors.

functions.name: Services_4_BookAppointment

functions.name: Travel_1_FindAttractions
functions.description: Retrieves a list of attractions within a specified city, filtered by entry fee, category, and suitability for children.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The name of the city or town where attractions are being searched for, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country'; for example, 'Paris, France' or 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: free_entry
parameters.description: A flag indicating if only attractions with no entry fee should be listed. Use 'True' for free attractions, 'False' for paid, and 'dontcare' for no preference.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category of attractions to filter by, such as 'Museum' or 'Park'. The 'dontcare' option includes all categories.

parameters.name: good_for_kids
parameters.description: Indicates whether to filter attractions based on their suitability for children. Options are 'True' for child-friendly attractions, 'False' for attractions not suitable for children, and 'dontcare' for no preference.

functions.name: Trains_1_GetTrainTickets
functions.description: Reserves tickets for a train journey between specified cities on a given date and time.

parameters.name: _from
parameters.description: The departure city for the train journey, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'New York, NY').

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The arrival city for the train journey, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'Los Angeles, CA').

parameters.name: date_of_journey
parameters.description: The date of the train journey, in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY' (e.g., '04/23/2023').

parameters.name: journey_start_time
parameters.description: The starting time of the train journey, in 24-hour format 'HH:MM' (e.g., '13:45' for 1:45 PM).

parameters.name: number_of_adults
parameters.description: The number of adults to reserve train tickets for.

parameters.name: trip_protection
parameters.description: Indicates whether to add trip protection to the reservation, for an additional fee.

parameters.name: _class
parameters.description: The fare class for the train reservation.

functions.name: Trains_1_FindTrains
functions.description: Finds available trains to a specified destination city on a particular date, allowing for reservation in different fare classes.

parameters.name: _from
parameters.description: The name of the starting city for the train journey, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'. State names must be abbreviated

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The destination city for the train journey, formatted as 'City, State', for instance 'Los Angeles, CA'. State names must be abbreviated

parameters.name: date_of_journey
parameters.description: The date of the train journey, in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY', e.g., '04/25/2023'.

parameters.name: _class
parameters.description: The fare class for the train reservation.

parameters.name: number_of_adults
parameters.description: The number of adults for whom train tickets are to be reserved.

functions.name: Travel_1_FindAttractions
functions.description: Browse attractions in a given city, filtering based on entry fee, category, and suitability for children.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The name of the city or town where the attraction is located, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country'. For example, 'San Francisco, CA' or 'Paris, France'.

parameters.name: free_entry
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the attraction has free entry. 'True' for attractions with no entry fee, 'False' for attractions with an entry fee, and 'dontcare' for no preference.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category to which the attraction belongs. The category can be a type of venue or activity offered.

parameters.name: good_for_kids
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the attraction is suitable for children. 'True' if the attraction is kid-friendly, 'False' if it is not, and 'dontcare' for no preference.

parameters.description: The return date for the inbound flight, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.description: The total number of tickets to book for the trip.

functions.name: Trains_1_GetTrainTickets
functions.description: Reserve train tickets for a specified journey between two cities on a given date and time, with options for the number of adults, trip protection, and fare class.

parameters.name: _from
parameters.description: The departure city for the train journey, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'New York, NY').

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The destination city for the train journey, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'Los Angeles, CA').

parameters.name: date_of_journey
parameters.description: The date of the train journey in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g., '2023-04-15').

parameters.name: journey_start_time
parameters.description: The departure time for the train journey in 24-hour format 'HH:MM' (e.g., '13:45').

parameters.name: number_of_adults
parameters.description: The number of adults to reserve train tickets for.

parameters.name: trip_protection
parameters.description: Indicates whether to add trip protection to the reservation, which incurs an additional fee.

parameters.name: _class
parameters.description: The fare class for the train reservation.

functions.name: Trains_1_FindTrains
functions.description: Finds available train services to a specified destination city on a given date, allowing for reservation in different fare classes.

parameters.name: _from
parameters.description: The name of the starting city for the train journey, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Los Angeles, CA'.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The destination city for the train journey, also in the format of 'City, State', like 'Chicago, IL'.

parameters.name: date_of_journey
parameters.description: The date on which the train journey is scheduled, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: _class
parameters.description: The fare class for the train reservation.

parameters.name: number_of_adults
parameters.description: The number of adults for whom the train tickets are to be reserved. Must be an integer between 1 and 5.

parameters.description: The total count of tickets to be bought.

parameters.description: The date when the show is scheduled, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.description: The location of the theater, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' and 'New York, NY'.

functions.name: Movies_1_FindMovies
functions.description: Search for movies by location, genre, or other attributes at various theaters.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city where the theater is located, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'Los Angeles, CA'). State names must be abbreviated

parameters.name: theater_name
parameters.description: The name of the theater. If no specific theater is desired, the search will include all theaters.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: The genre of the movie. If no specific genre is desired, the search will include all genres.

parameters.name: show_type
parameters.description: The type of movie show. Options include regular screenings, 3D, and IMAX formats. If no preference is indicated, all types will be included in the search.

functions.name: Movies_1_GetTimesForMovie
functions.description: Retrieves the showtimes for a specific movie at a given theater location on a particular date.

parameters.name: movie_name
parameters.description: The title of the movie for which showtimes are being requested.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The location of the theater in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: show_date
parameters.description: The date when the show will be screened, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: theater_name
parameters.description: The name of the theater where the movie is showing. If unspecified, any theater is considered.

parameters.name: show_type
parameters.description: The format of the movie showing, such as 'regular', '3D', or 'IMAX'.

functions.name: Music_3_PlayMedia
functions.description: Initiates playback of a specified music track on a designated device.

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: The title of the song to be played.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: The name of the artist performing the track. When unspecified, any artist is acceptable.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: The name of the device where the music will be played, such as 'Living room speaker' or 'Kitchen sound system'.

parameters.name: album
parameters.description: The name of the album that the track is part of. Optional and when unspecified, any album is acceptable.

functions.name: Hotels_2_SearchHouse

parameters.description: The format of the movie showing.

functions.name: Movies_1_FindMovies
functions.description: Search for movies by specified criteria such as location, genre, and show type.

parameters.description: The city where the theater is located, in the format of 'City, State' such as 'Los Angeles, CA'.

parameters.description: The name of the theater. If unspecified, all theaters are considered.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: The genre of the movie. If unspecified, all genres are considered.

parameters.name: show_type
parameters.description: The type of movie show such as regular, 3D, or IMAX. If unspecified, all types are considered.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: The type of cultural event to find.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city in which to search for events, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'New York, NY').

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date for which to find events, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If set to 'dontcare', any date is considered.

parameters.description: The quantity of tickets to be reserved for the event.

parameters.name: date

functions.name: Hotels_4_ReserveHotel

parameters.description: The name of the hotel or accommodation.

parameters.name: stay_length
parameters.description: The length of stay in number of days.

parameters.name: location

parameters.name: number_of_rooms
parameters.description: The number of rooms to reserve.

functions.name: Hotels_4_SearchHotel

parameters.description: The city or town where the accommodation is being searched for. Format: 'City, Country' if the city does not locate in the United States (e.g., 'Paris, FR').

parameters.description: Indicates whether smoking is allowed inside the accommodation.

parameters.name: origin_airport
parameters.description: The IATA code or the name of the airport or city to depart from, such as 'JFK' for John F. Kennedy International Airport.

parameters.name: destination_airport
parameters.description: The IATA code or the name of the airport or city to arrive at, such as 'LAX' for Los Angeles International Airport.

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.description: The start date of the trip in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD', for example '2023-07-15'.

parameters.name: seating_class
parameters.description: The cabin seat option for the flight.

parameters.name: number_of_tickets
parameters.description: The number of flight tickets required for the trip.

parameters.name: airlines
parameters.description: The preferred airline company for the flight. Select 'dontcare' if no preference.

functions.name: Flights_4_SearchRoundtripFlights
functions.description: Search for roundtrip flights based on specified criteria, including departure and return dates, airports, seating class, number of tickets, and preferred airlines.

parameters.name: origin_airport
parameters.description: The IATA code or name of the airport or city to depart from, such as 'JFK' for John F. Kennedy International Airport.

parameters.name: destination_airport
parameters.description: The IATA code or name of the airport or city to arrive at, such as 'LAX' for Los Angeles International Airport.

parameters.name: departure_date
parameters.description: The start date of the trip, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: return_date
parameters.description: The end date of the trip, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: seating_class
parameters.description: The cabin seat option for the flight.

parameters.name: number_of_tickets
parameters.description: The number of flight tickets required for the trip.

parameters.name: airlines
parameters.description: The preferred airline for the trip. Use 'dontcare' if there is no preference.

functions.name: Hotels_4_ReserveHotel
functions.description: Reserve rooms at a selected hotel for given dates.

parameters.name: place_name
parameters.description: The name of the hotel or accommodation.

parameters.name: check_in_date
parameters.description: The check-in date for the reservation, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: stay_length
parameters.description: The length of the stay in number of days.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city or town where the accommodation is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: number_of_rooms
parameters.description: The number of rooms to reserve.

functions.name: Hotels_4_SearchHotel
functions.description: Search for accommodations in a specific city, filtering results based on star rating, smoking policy, and the number of rooms required.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city or town where the accommodation is sought, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country' if the city does not locate in the United States; for example, 'New York, NY' or 'Paris, FR'.

parameters.description: The desired star rating for the accommodation.

functions.name: Events_3_FindEvents
functions.description: Finds cultural events, such as concerts and plays, happening in a specified city on a given date.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: The type of cultural event to find.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city in which to search for events, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' and 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date of the event, formatted as 'MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, the search will include events for all upcoming dates.

functions.name: Events_3_BuyEventTickets
functions.description: Purchase tickets for a specified cultural event on a particular date in a selected city.

parameters.name: event_name
parameters.description: The name of the artist, play, or cultural event.

parameters.name: number_of_tickets
parameters.description: The quantity of tickets to purchase. Must be a positive integer and typically ranges from 1 to 8.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The specific date of the event, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city where the event will take place, formatted as 'City, State' or 'City, Country' if the city does not locate in the United States, such as 'New York, NY' or 'London, UK'.

functions.name: Movies_3_FindMovies
functions.description: Retrieve a list of movies based on specified criteria that match the user's preferences.

parameters.name: directed_by
parameters.description: The first and last name of the director of the movies to filter by. Use 'dontcare' if the director is not a filtering criterion.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: The genre of the movies to filter by. Select 'dontcare' to include all genres.

parameters.name: cast
parameters.description: First and last names of lead actors or actresses in the movies to filter by. Use 'dontcare' if the cast is not a filtering criterion.

example.query: Can you find me an offbeat movie directed by Wes Anderson?

functions.name: Travel_1_FindAttractions
functions.description: Browse attractions in a given city, with options to filter by free entry, category, and suitability for children.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city or town where the attraction is located, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country' if the city does not locate in the United States, such as 'Paris, FR' or 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: free_entry
parameters.description: Indicates whether entrance to the attraction is free. True for free entry, False for paid entry, and a value indicating indifference.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category to which the attraction belongs. This parameter helps in refining the search to specific types of attractions.

parameters.name: good_for_kids
parameters.description: Indicates whether the attraction is suitable for children. True for suitable, False for not suitable, and a value for no preference.

functions.name: Music_3_PlayMedia
functions.description: Plays the specified music track on a designated media player device.

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: The title of the song to be played.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: The name of the artist performing the song. If unspecified, any artist will be considered.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: The name of the device or location where the music will be played.

parameters.name: album

functions.name: Music_3_LookupMusic
functions.description: Discover songs that align with your musical preferences by specifying the artist, album, genre, and release year.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: The first and last name of the artist or the name of the band you are interested in. Use 'dontcare' if you have no preference.

parameters.name: album
parameters.description: The album title that contains the songs you are looking for. Use 'dontcare' if you have no preference.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: The music genre of the songs you want to find. Use 'dontcare' to include all genres.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The year of release for the music you're searching for, formatted as 'YYYY'. Use 'dontcare' if the release year is not a concern.

functions.name: Travel_1_FindAttractions
functions.description: Browse attractions in a given city, filtering by free entry status, attraction category, and suitability for children.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The city or town where the attraction is located, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country' if the city does not locate in the United States, such as 'Orlando, FL' or 'Paris, FR'.

parameters.name: free_entry
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the entrance to the attraction is free. If set to 'dontcare', it will include all attractions regardless of their entry fee status.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category to which the attraction belongs. If set to 'dontcare', it will include attractions from all categories.

parameters.name: good_for_kids
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the attraction is suitable for children. If set to 'dontcare', it will include attractions regardless of their suitability for children.

parameters.description: The full name of the restaurant where the reservation is to be made.

parameters.description: The location of the restaurant in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'.

functions.name: Restaurants_2_FindRestaurants

parameters.description: The type of cuisine or food category offered by the restaurant.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The location of the restaurant, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' and 'New York, NY'.

parameters.name: price_range
parameters.description: The general price range for dining at the restaurant.

parameters.name: has_vegetarian_options
parameters.description: Indicates whether the restaurant offers a selection of vegetarian dishes.

parameters.name: has_seating_outdoors
parameters.description: Specifies if the restaurant provides outdoor seating for customers.

functions.name: Services_1_BookAppointment
functions.description: This function books an appointment with a specified hair stylist or salon for hairdressing services. It requires the name of the stylist or salon, as well as the desired time and date for the appointment.

parameters.name: stylist_name
parameters.description: The full name of the hair stylist or the name of the salon where the appointment will be booked.

parameters.name: appointment_time
parameters.description: The specific time for the appointment, in 24-hour format 'HH:MM'.

parameters.name: appointment_date
parameters.description: The date for the appointment, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.name: service_type
parameters.description: The type of service requested for the appointment.

parameters.name: contact_number
parameters.description: The contact phone number for appointment confirmation, in the format '123-456-7890'.

parameters.name: confirmation_email
parameters.description: Whether a confirmation email should be sent. If true, an email is sent to the provided email address.

functions.name: Services_1_FindProvider
functions.description: Search for a hair stylist within a specified city, with the option to filter by whether the salon accommodates all genders.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city where the search for a hair stylist is targeted, in the format 'City, State', such as 'New York, NY' or 'Los Angeles, CA'.

parameters.name: is_unisex
parameters.description: Indicates if the salon should be unisex or not. A value of 'true' searches for unisex salons, 'false' for non-unisex salons.

example.query: Search for a unisex hair salon located in Emeryville, CA?

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: The city where the property is located, in the format of 'City, State' (e.g., 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY').

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: The intent to either rent or buy the property.

parameters.name: number_of_beds
parameters.description: The number of bedrooms in the property.

parameters.name: number_of_baths
parameters.description: The number of bathrooms in the property.

parameters.name: has_garage
parameters.description: Indicates whether the property includes a garage. The default is 'dontcare' which includes properties regardless of garage availability.

parameters.name: in_unit_laundry
parameters.description: Indicates whether the property has in-unit laundry facilities. The default is 'dontcare' which includes properties regardless of in-unit laundry facilities.

functions.name: Homes_2_ScheduleVisit
functions.description: Schedule a visit to a property on a given date. The visit date should be specified in the 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. This function helps in arranging a tour for the interested parties to explore the property and facilities.

parameters.name: property_name
parameters.description: The exact name of the property or apartment complex to visit.

parameters.name: visit_date
parameters.description: The scheduled date for the property visit, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

example.query: Could you tell me what the weather will be like in Pinole, CA on March 21st, 2023?

parameters.description: The date of the train journey, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

parameters.description: The fare class for the train reservation.

parameters.description: The end date and time of the availability period for the service provider, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'. A default value of 'null' represents an open end date.

parameters.name: available_for_pet
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the service provider is available for households with pets. 'false' means not available for pets; 'true' means they are.

parameters.name: job_qty
parameters.description: The number of jobs the service provider has completed. A default value of 'null' indicates no job history available.

parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the service provider offers condo cleaning services. 'false' means they do not offer such services; 'true' means they do.

parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the service provider offers home cleaning services. 'false' means they do not offer such services; 'true' means they do.

parameters.name: is_cleaning_office
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the service provider offers office cleaning services. 'false' means they do not offer such services; 'true' means they do.

functions.name: set_alarm
functions.description: Set an alarm for a specific time. The time can be specified in various standardized formats, such as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' for specific date and time, 'HH:MM:SS' for time of the day, or 'HH:MM' for a shorter version without seconds. AM/PM can also be used to specify the time, for example, '9:30 AM'.

parameters.name: alarm_time
parameters.description: The alarm time in a standard 24-hour format ('HH:MM' or 'HH:MM:SS') or a standard 12-hour format with AM/PM ('HH:MM AM/PM'). Date can be included in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. Examples: '2023-06-01 09:30:00', '14:45', '9:30 AM'.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: The purpose of the alarm, such as 'wake up' or 'meeting'. Optional parameter.

functions.name: set_countdown
functions.description: Sets a countdown timer for a specified duration. The duration should be specified in a clear format, such as '1 hour 30 minutes', '45 minutes', or '2 hours'. Supported units are hours and minutes.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The countdown duration, expressed in a format such as '1 hour 30 minutes', '45 minutes', or '2 hours'. Examples include '1 hour', '30 minutes', '1 hr 15 mins'. The format should include a numeric time quantity followed by a space and a time unit ('hours' or 'minutes').

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: The purpose of setting the countdown timer. For example, 'baking', 'study session', or 'workout'.
